env: Grimy 1990s home bathroom: beige square wall tiles, stained old white toilet, weathered beige tile floor, one small window with soft daylight. Amateur handheld phone video look, photorealistic, vertical 9:16, slight grain, no studio lighting.
persona: The same 24-year-old American woman as the reference image: round friendly face, light freckles, long wavy auburn hair, light blue denim button-up shirt.

shots.prompt: Selfie video still: she holds the phone at arm's length, talking straight to camera with an excited open-mouth smile, mid-word.
Glossy architectural render of a dream bathroom: white ceramic pedestal basin, warm oak floor, large bright window, soft daylight, minimalist, high-end interior visualisation, clean and perfect.
She looks down at her phone in her hand, nodding, eyebrows raised, phone screen glowing.
She is laughing with her head slightly back, one flat hand raised as if to say 'I warned you'.
Extreme close-up: a hand grips and yanks an old ceramic toilet-roll holder off the tiled wall. Dust and tile crumbs fly. Shallow depth of field.
Extreme close-up of black mould creeping along the grout lines between beige bathroom floor tiles. Damp, unappealing, shallow depth of field.
Close-up of an old cracked ceramic washbasin with a dripping chrome tap, water stain rings, a thin stream of water falling.
She holds her phone up toward the camera showing a bright bathroom render on the screen, her face exasperated, eyebrows high, mouth open.
She stands up from the bathroom floor, hands on hips, chin up, determined and confident expression.
Close-up of two hands cutting a cardboard ring with scissors on a tiled bathroom floor, cardboard curls and offcuts around.
A glossy red plastic bucket sitting inside a ring of draped red fabric on the bathroom floor, freshly positioned by two hands.
A hand holds an open green umbrella directly above the red bucket while water pours off the outside of the umbrella down into the bucket. Absurd, comedic.
A heavy grey concrete block dropped into the red plastic bucket, dust puffing outward, motion captured mid-drop.
The red bucket with a concrete block inside, fine grey dust drifting in the air, bathroom floor around it, near-still moment.
She crouches on the bathroom floor, holding the phone so the bright bathroom render shows beside the red bucket in front of her, glancing between the two, sceptical expression.
Two hands pull a red cloth taut around the base of the bucket to form a skirt, on the tiled bathroom floor.
She wipes her forehead with the back of her hand and exhales with a proud, tired grin at the camera, standing in the bathroom.
She presents the completed bucket-with-cloth-skirt washbasin with both hands open, showgirl flourish, big proud smile, standing beside it.
Close-up of the finished fake washbasin: red plastic bucket on a draped red cloth skirt topped with a chrome tap, sitting against beige bathroom tiles.
She crouches beside the old white toilet holding an empty glass fish tank up toward the camera, grinning.
A plastic bag of colourful aquarium decorations and fake plants spilled open on the tiled bathroom floor, a hand sorting through them.
Two hands pour water from a clear plastic jug into a glass fish tank, water streaming and rippling, bathroom floor below.
A hand presses a chrome toilet flush valve against the bare beige tiled bathroom wall, as if trying to install it there. Confused, absurd.
She stands with arms folded staring deadpan into the camera, unimpressed, slight head tilt, bathroom behind her.
Close-up of two hands assembling a white plastic toilet flush mechanism on the tiled bathroom floor, parts and screws around.
Top-down view of the toilet tank open, a hand lowering a fresh flush mechanism into the water, ready to seat it.
She turns from the toilet toward the camera with a hand on her hip, presenting the finished corner, half-smiling.

Wide shot of the finished improvised bathroom corner: the red bucket washbasin with cloth skirt on the left, the old white toilet in the middle, a glass fish tank with fish on the right. Messy, funny, deadpan proud.
Extreme close-up of a chrome tap running water into a red plastic bucket, water splashing, stuttering stream.
She stares deadpan at the old white toilet, then begins to turn her head toward the camera, expression flat and defeated.
She sits on the bathroom floor with her back against the wall, tired, laughing at herself, shoulders dropped, phone in her lap.
She holds the phone up and pans it across the messy bathroom corner, looking helpless and pleading at the camera, one eyebrow raised.
